name: Hallow Wind Eagles at the abbey entrance stay on the bridge deck (#13339)
contract: #13339: Hallow Wind Eagle 164195, the kill credit of Justice May be Blind, But it is Not Deaf (175345), walks on the ground, and the entrance spawn 9962114 had a 15 yd wander. The server navmesh has only the layer under the bridge at points 8-11 yd from it, so the eagle wandered below the deck, could not path back to players and reset. rev_20261123_13339_hallow_wind_entrance_eagle_wander.sql sets it to 5 yd, within which every point keeps the deck (the eagles within 60 yd of the reporter's spot now wander at most 6.7 yd). A player at the reporter's spot samples every 5 s for 60 s that no eagle is more than 7.5 yd from home. Before the fix 9962114 chose a point beyond 7.5 yd on about 75% of its moves (uniform over a 15 yd disc), so twelve samples over about six moves fail the broken tree with near certainty.
